scope: LibreCAD_3 opt-in installed ABI-3 codec and standard LTYPE compatibility
findings: The earlier installed-codec tests used a temporary unversioned CMake edit; the current LibreCAD_3 candidate had no reproducible installed-package option.

The 3.x writer rejected canonical LTYPE callbacks because the adapter carried CONTINUOUS's 'Solid line' description into ByLayer and ByBlock. Three existing save/MPOLYGON checks failed on ABI-3 but passed with pinned 2.0.0. Clearing the carried-over description restored them without weakening the writer's metadata guard.

Two older round-trip tests treated false from File::save as proof that no file was written. The documented bool contract also returns false for a successful lossy export. Both pinned and 3.x paths reproduced the same test failures for reported R12/R14 lineweight loss. The updated tests check exportFile.ok and require exactly the expected legacy loss; a separate control checks that bool save returns false while the partial file can be reopened.
change: Add an opt-in system codec requiring the 3.0 CMake package while leaving the pinned codec as default; preserve installed runtime staging search and honest build-version provenance. Remove the pre-existing pinned-codec -Wno-error override. Reset the unintended canonical description, clarify the bool-save field-loss documentation, and keep legacy loss visible in tests.

verification.configure: PASS: installed shared 3.0.0 and pinned d68fb1ed 2.0.0 modes; installed 2.0.1 rejected. Persistence-disabled and WITH_HEADERS configurations generate. Python-enabled system configuration points its staging search to the selected installed library directory; actual Python app install was not run.
verification.build: PASS: clean macOS ARM64 Release persistence and temporary local-only focused test target with each provider. The installed persistence dylib links to @rpath/libdxfrw.3.dylib; pinned persistence uses its static bundled library. Both libdxfrw builds keep their warnings-as-errors behavior. Consumer code emits pre-existing missing-override warnings.
verification.build_metadata: PASS: system build reports 3.0.0; archive-based pinned build reports 2.0.0 without mistaking the parent LibreCAD_3 Git commit for the submodule commit.
verification.tests: PASS: 14 focused tests with each provider, no skips. They cover all advertised DXF save types, ASCII/Binary round trips, 3D segment, MPOLYGON, legacy lineweight and bool-save behavior, and MLINE/WIPEOUT/MULTILEADER/modeler/underlay/SHAPE loss reports. ODA-converted scratch samples were hash-verified against earlier receipts; none were added to Git.
verification.replay: PASS: the prior cumulative candidate and the follow-up patch replay onto current master 4fb4831; all ten changed files match the tested candidate. The two local commits are unmerged and unpublished.

limits: The focused target was added temporarily to the scratch CMake file for testing and removed before the patch. This is not a clean full application/GUI install, native Linux/Windows run, complete ABI comparison, native 3D semantic proof, or upstream integration. The model does not yet distinguish absent legacy lineweight from an explicit value, so default-width provenance remains open. No broad support claim or external gate is promoted.
